exposure: Blastocyst-stage biopsy with frozen embryo transfer (BB-FET)
Cleavage-stage biopsy with fresh embryo transfer (CB-ET)
cohort: The study included data from 317 women and their neonates born after preimplantation genetic diagnosis/screening (PGD/PGS).
finding: Blastocyst-stage biopsy with frozen embryo transfer (BB-FET) was associated with a higher incidence of gestational hypertension but better neonatal outcomes, particularly higher birthweight and longer gestational age in twins, compared to cleavage-stage biopsy with fresh embryo transfer (CB-ET).
